en.s: The Battle of the Frigidus, also called the Battle of the Frigid River, was fought on 5 and 6 September 394 between the armies of the Roman emperor Theodosius the Great and the rebel augustus Eugenius (r. 392–394), in the eastern border of Roman Italy. Theodosius won the battle and defeated the usurpation of Eugenius and Arbogast, restoring unity to the Roman Empire. The battlefield, in the Claustra Alpium Iuliarum near the Julian Alps through which Theodosius's army had passed, was probably in the Vipava Valley – with the Frigidus River being the modern Vipava – or possibly in the valley of the Isonzo.

zh.s: 弗里吉杜斯河战役也称寒河战役，于394年9月5日和6日在罗马意大利东部边境进行，交战双方是罗马皇帝狄奥多西一世的军队和叛乱皇帝欧根尼乌斯（在位392—394年）的军队。狄奥多西获胜，平定了欧根尼乌斯和阿波加斯特的篡位，恢复罗马帝国统一。战场位于朱利安阿尔卑斯山附近的朱利安阿尔卑斯山口防御工事一带，可能在维帕瓦河谷（弗里吉杜斯河即今维帕瓦河），也可能在伊松佐河谷。

en.s: The siege of Kronborg (Danish: Belejringen af Kronborg; Swedish: Belägring av Kronborg) was a Swedish siege of the Danish stronghold Kronborg from 16 August to 6 September 1658, during the Dano-Swedish War of 1658–1660. The siege ended with a Swedish victory. The Swedish besiegers, being led by Carl Gustaf Wrangel, successfully made the Danish commander surrender after spreading rumours that Copenhagen had fallen to the Swedes and convincing him that continued resistance was futile.

Lieutenant General Sir Henry Clinton ordered General Arnold to raid the Connecticut port of New London in an unsuccessful attempt to divert General George Washington from marching against Lord Cornwallis's army in Virginia.

en.s: The Battle of Feistritz (6 September 1813) saw an Imperial French corps led by Paul Grenier attack an Austrian brigade under August von Vécsey. After putting up a stout resistance, the outnumbered Austrians were defeated and forced to retreat. The clash occurred during the War of the Sixth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars. Feistritz im Rosental is located on the Drau River near the southern border of Austria, about 16 kilometres (10 mi) southwest of Klagenfurt. When hostilities commenced between the Austrian Empire and Imperial France, Johann von Hiller led an Austrian army to attack the Illyrian Provinces.

zh.s: 1813年9月6日，保罗·格雷尼耶率领的法军军团进攻奥古斯特·冯·韦切伊指挥的奥地利旅。奥地利军队寡不敌众，但进行了顽强抵抗，最终战败撤退。这场战斗发生在第六次反法同盟战争期间，属于拿破仑战争的一部分。费斯特里茨位于奥地利南部边境附近的德拉瓦河畔，距克拉根福西南约16公里。奥地利帝国与法兰西帝国开战后，约翰·冯·希勒率领奥军进攻伊利里亚省。

en.s: The Battle of Batorz of September 6, 1863, also known as the Battle of Sowia Góra hill near the village of Batorz, was one of many battles of the January Uprising against the tsarist oppression. It took place in the Russian-controlled Congress Poland. During the battle, a party of 700 Polish insurgents, together with Hungarian volunteers, and commanded by Marcin Borelowski, clashed with soldiers of the Imperial Russian Army. The battle resulted in Russian victory. After the Battle of Panasowka, Borelowski ordered his party to march towards Goraj.

en.s: The 1930 Argentine coup d'état also known as the September Revolution by supporters of it, involved the overthrow of the Argentine government of Hipólito Yrigoyen by forces loyal to General José Félix Uriburu. The coup took place on 6 September 1930 when Uriburu led a small detachment of troops loyal to him into the capital, experiencing no substantial opposition and taking control of the Casa Rosada. Large crowds formed in Buenos Aires in support of the coup. Uriburu's forces took control of the capital and arrested Radical Civic Union supporters. There were no casualties in the coup.

en.s: The Battle of Różan, otherwise known as defence of Różan bridgehead, took place between September 4 and September 6, 1939, in the fields before the town of Różan on the Narew River. A small Polish garrison of three World War I forts (consisting of two infantry battalions) successfully defended the bridgehead against the entire German panzer division for the entire day and night. However, as a result of a misunderstanding of the commander in chief's orders, the Polish forces were then withdrawn to the other side of the river, and then further eastwards on September 6.

en.s: Battle of Tomaszów Mazowiecki (Polish: Bitwa pod Tomaszowem Mazowieckim) refers to the battle on 6 September 1939 near the town of Tomaszów Mazowiecki, Second Polish Republic, during the Invasion of Poland. The area was defended by Polish 13th Infantry Division under Col. Władysław Zubosz-Kaliński, and Germany's assault was carried by two armored divisions of the 16th Panzer Corps. After the day-long battle, German forces broke through the Polish defences and took the town. Polish 13th Division sustained heavy losses and was forced to retreat towards Warsaw.

en.s: The Battle of Barking Creek was a friendly fire incident over the East Coast of England in the earliest days of the Second World War. On 6 September 1939, aircraft from several 11 Group, RAF Fighter Command squadrons, were scrambled to intercept German aircraft detected by radar (RDF) flying towards the English coast. The radar plots were reflections of British aircraft flying inland. Spitfire fighters sent to intercept shot down two Hurricanes in error, killing one of the pilots, the first death of a British fighter pilot in the war.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战初期，英格兰东海岸上空发生了一起误击事件，后称巴金溪战役。1939年9月6日，英国皇家空军战斗机司令部第11大队的多个中队紧急出动，拦截雷达（RDF）发现的、飞向英格兰海岸的德国飞机。雷达信号其实是飞往内陆的英国飞机反射所致。前去拦截的喷火式战斗机误击了两架飓风式战斗机，其中一名飞行员死亡，这是战争中首位阵亡的英国战斗机飞行员。

en.t: King Carol II of Romania abdicates and is succeeded by his son Michael. General Ion Antonescu becomes the Conducător of Romania
en.s: Carol II (15 October 1893 [O.S. 3 October 1893] – 4 April 1953) was King of Romania from 8 June 1930 following a coup that deposed his son, until his forced abdication on 6 September 1940. en.s: Operation Houndsworth was a British Special Air Service operation during World War II. The operation, carried out by "A" Squadron, 1st Special Air Service between 6 June and 6 September 1944, was centred on Dijon in the Burgundy region of France. Their objective was to disrupt German lines of communication, coordinate the activities of the French Resistance and prevent German reinforcements moving to the Normandy beachheads, especially the 2nd SS Panzer Division Das Reich.

en.s: On 6 September 1952, a prototype de Havilland DH.110 jet fighter crashed during an aerial display at the Farnborough Airshow in Hampshire, England. The jet disintegrated mid-air during an aerobatic manoeuvre, killing pilot John Derry and onboard flight test observer Anthony Richards. Debris fell onto a crowd of spectators, killing 29 and injuring 60. The cause was determined to be structural failure due to a design flaw in the wing's leading edge. All DH.110s were initially grounded, but after modification to its design, the type entered service with the Royal Navy as the Sea Vixen.

zh.s: 1952年9月6日，一架德哈维兰DH.110喷气式战斗机原型机在英格兰汉普郡法恩伯勒航展飞行表演时坠毁。飞机在特技动作中于空中解体，飞行员约翰·德里和机上飞行测试观察员安东尼·理查兹遇难。残骸落入观众人群，造成29人死亡、60人受伤。事故原因被认定为机翼前缘设计缺陷导致结构失效。所有DH.110飞机最初都停飞，设计修改后，该机型以“海狐”之名加入英国皇家海军服役。

en.t: Archaeologist Peter Marsden discovers the first of the Blackfriars Ships dating back to the second century AD in the Blackfriars area of the banks of the River Thames in London
en.s: The Blackfriars shipwrecks were a series of wrecks discovered by archaeologist Peter Marsden in the Blackfriars area of the banks of the River Thames in London, England. The wrecks were discovered while building a riverside embankment wall along the River Thames. Marsden discovered the first on 6 September 1962 and the other three were discovered in 1969–1970. Together they are now known as the four Blackfriars wrecks.

en.t: Dawson's Field hijackings begin with coordinated attacks on airliners
en.s: On September 6, 1970, members of the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine attempted coordinated hijackings of several international flights. TWA Flight 741 and Swissair Flight 100 were forced to land at Dawson's Field in Jordan, where passengers became hostages. A Pan Am flight was diverted to Cairo, while an attempt against an El Al flight failed. Further hijackings and the hostage crisis continued over the following days.
en.n: The first coordinated hijackings took place September 6, 1970; the wider Dawson's Field crisis continued afterward.

zh.t: 道森机场劫机事件开始
zh.s: 1970年9月6日，解放巴勒斯坦人民阵线成员同时试图劫持多架国际航班。环球航空741号班机和瑞士航空100号班机被迫降落在约旦的道森机场，乘客遭扣为人质；泛美航空一架班机被改道飞往开罗，劫持以色列航空班机的行动则告失败。劫机与人质危机此后持续多日。
zh.n: 首批协同劫机发生在1970年9月6日，整场人质危机持续到之后数日。

en.s: The Munich massacre was a terrorist attack during the 1972 Summer Olympics in Munich, West Germany, carried out by eight members of the Palestinian militant organisation Black September. The militants infiltrated the Olympic Village, killed two members of the Israeli Olympic team, and took nine other Israeli team members hostage. Those hostages were later also killed by the militants during a failed rescue attempt.
en.n: Munich massacre: Nine Israeli athletes die (along with a German policeman) at the hands of the Palestinian "Black September" terrorist group after being taken hostage at the Munich Olympic Games. Two other Israeli athletes were slain in the initial attack the previous day.

en.t: Soviet State Council recognizes the independence of the Baltic states
en.s: On September 6, 1991, the Soviet Union's State Council formally recognized the independence of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. en.t: Mahmoud Abbas submits his resignation as Palestinian prime minister
en.s: On September 6, 2003, Mahmoud Abbas submitted his resignation as prime minister of the Palestinian Authority after months of disputes over his powers and the peace process. He had taken the newly created post earlier that year. A later presidential decree formally accepted the resignation; the September 6 event was his decision and submission.
en.n: Abbas submitted his resignation September 6, 2003; the formal acceptance followed by presidential decree.

zh.t: 马哈茂德·阿巴斯递交巴勒斯坦总理辞呈
zh.s: 2003年9月6日，马哈茂德·阿巴斯因总理权限及和平进程问题上的长期分歧，递交了巴勒斯坦自治政府总理辞呈。他当年较早时才出任这一新设职务。总统后来通过法令正式接受辞呈；9月6日发生的是阿巴斯提出辞职。
zh.n: 阿巴斯于2003年9月6日递交辞呈，正式获准辞职是在此后的总统法令中。

en.s: Operation Orchard (Hebrew: מבצע בוסתן‎‎, Mivtza bustan) was an alleged Israeli airstrike on a suspected nuclear reactor in the Deir ez-Zor region of Syria, which occurred just after midnight (local time) on September 6, 2007. The Israeli and U.S. governments imposed virtually total news blackouts immediately after the raid that held for seven months.

zh.s: “果园行动”（希伯来语：מבצע בוסתן，Mivtza bustan）据称是以色列对叙利亚代尔祖尔地区一处疑似核反应堆发动的空袭，发生在2007年9月6日当地时间午夜刚过。空袭后，以色列和美国政府立即实行几乎全面的新闻封锁，持续了7个月。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Mayo, located in Adelaide, South Australia, on 6 September 2008, following the retirement of Liberal Party MP and former Liberal leader Alexander Downer. The by-election was held on the same day as the Lyne by-election, and the Western Australian state election. The writ for the by-election was issued 4 August, with the rolls closing on 8 August. Candidate nominations closed on 14 August. The by-election was contested on the same boundaries drawn for Mayo at the 2007 federal election.

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held on 6 September 2008 in Pakistan. The Electoral College of Pakistan – a joint sitting of the Senate, National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies – elected a new President after the resignation of President Pervez Musharraf. As required by the constitution, Muhammad Mian Soomro (in his position as Chairman of the Senate of Pakistan) automatically became acting President on 18 August 2008, upon the resignation of Musharraf. The constitution required that a new President be elected by Parliament within 30 days; Soomro was considered loyal to Musharraf, and it was considered certain that he would be replaced in that election.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦于2008年9月6日举行间接总统选举。佩尔韦兹·穆沙拉夫辞职后，由参议院、国民议会和各省议会联席组成的选举团选出新总统。穆沙拉夫于2008年8月18日辞职后，巴基斯坦参议院主席穆罕默德·米安·苏姆罗依照宪法自动出任代总统。宪法规定议会须在30天内选出新总统。苏姆罗被认为忠于穆沙拉夫，因此外界普遍认为他会在此次选举中被替换。

zh.s: 2009年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛于2009年9月6日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，由基尔肯尼对阵蒂珀雷里。这是两队自1991年以来首次在全爱尔兰决赛中相遇。基尔肯尼获胜，连续第四次夺冠；上一次有球队做到这一点，是科克在1941年至1944年间。

Wrestlers were portrayed as either villains or heroes in the scripted events that build tension and culminate into a wrestling match or series of matches. en.t: The ro-ro ferry SuperFerry 9 sinks off the Zamboanga Peninsula in the Philippines with 971 persons aboard; all but ten are rescued
en.s: SuperFerry 9 was a ferry owned by the Philippines-based carrier Aboitiz Transport System Corp (ATSC) and operated by their SuperFerry division. About 9 a.m. Sunday, September 6, 2009, she sank off the south-west coast of Zamboanga Peninsula with a total of 971 passengers and crew aboard. The ferry was travelling from the southern city of General Santos to Iloilo City in the central Philippines and capsized on the other side of the peninsula from Zamboanga City.

zh.t: 滚装渡轮SuperFerry 9在菲律宾三宝颜半岛附近沉没，船上971人中除10人外均获救
zh.s: SuperFerry 9号渡轮归菲律宾航运公司阿博伊蒂斯运输系统公司所有，由该公司的SuperFerry部门运营。2009年9月6日星期日上午约9时，渡轮在三宝颜半岛西南海岸附近沉没，船上共有971名乘客和船员。当时渡轮正从南部城市桑托斯将军城驶往菲律宾中部的伊洛伊洛市，在三宝颜市所在半岛的另一侧倾覆。

en.s: Ruleta de la Muerte (2012) (Spanish for "Roulette of death") was an annual professional wrestling major event produced and scripted by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), which took place on September 6, 2012 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. The focal point of the event was the eponymous Ruleta de la Muerte eight-man tournament where all participants put their wrestling mask or hair on the line. The Ruleta de la Muerte tournament is a Lucha libre stable, a tournament which unlike traditional tournaments it is the loser that advances in the tournament, advancing to the final that is contested under Luchas de Apuestas or bet rules.

en.t: September 2012 Baradan Bay, Turkey, migrant boat disaster
en.s: The September 2012 Baradan Bay, Turkey migrant boat disaster occurred in the early hours of September 6, 2012, in Baradan Bay, İzmir Province, western Turkey. A fishing boat carrying illegal migrants hit rocks and sank. 61 people died, 48 survived the incident. The 12 m (39 ft) long fishing boat left the village of Ahmetbeyli in the Menderes district of İzmir Province at 5:30 AM heading for the island of Samos to enter Greece illegally.

en.t: Ukraine launches a counteroffensive in Kharkiv region
en.s: On September 6, 2022, Ukrainian forces launched a counteroffensive against Russian positions in Kharkiv region, beginning a rapid advance that surprised Russian troops. The first attacks targeted positions east and southeast of Kharkiv city. Ukrainian forces retook Balakliia and other places over the following days; the broader territorial gains were not all achieved on September 6.
en.n: The Kharkiv counteroffensive began September 6, 2022; most reported territorial gains followed in the ensuing days.

zh.t: 乌克兰在哈尔科夫州发起反攻
zh.s: 2022年9月6日，乌克兰军队向哈尔科夫市以东及东南方向的俄军阵地发起反攻，迅速推进，令俄军措手不及。乌军在随后几天收复巴拉克利亚等地；这些战果并非都发生在反攻首日。
zh.n: 反攻于2022年9月6日开始，大部分领土收复发生在随后几天。

en.t: Boris Johnson resigns and Liz Truss becomes UK prime minister
en.s: On September 6, 2022, Boris Johnson went to Balmoral Castle to resign as UK prime minister. Queen Elizabeth II then invited Liz Truss, elected Conservative leader the previous day, to form a government. It was one of the Queen's final official duties; she died two days later.
en.n: The change of prime minister took place September 6, 2022; Truss had won the Conservative leadership vote September 5.

zh.t: 鲍里斯·约翰逊辞职，利兹·特拉斯出任英国首相
zh.s: 2022年9月6日，鲍里斯·约翰逊前往巴尔莫勒尔堡向英国女王伊丽莎白二世辞去首相职务。女王随后邀请前一天当选保守党领袖的利兹·特拉斯组建政府。两天后女王去世，这成为她生前最后的公务之一。
zh.n: 首相交接发生在2022年9月6日；特拉斯是在前一天赢得保守党领袖选举。

en.t: 2024 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: The 2024 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election was held on 6 September 2024, with a party national congress that was expected to be held in Braga on 21 and 22 September 2024, but it was postponed to 19 and 20 October 2024 due to the September 2024 wildfire crisis. This leadership election was held with Luís Montenegro holding the office of Prime Minister, following his win in the 2024 March early legislative election.

en.s: The 2026 Saxony-Anhalt state election was held on 6 September 2026 to elect the 9th Landtag of Saxony-Anhalt. It took place two weeks before the state elections in Berlin and in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. This election drew significant national and international attention due to the performance of the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD), including the possibility of it getting an absolute majority.

zh.s: 萨克森-安哈尔特州于2026年9月6日举行州选举，选出该州第九届州议会议员。选举时间比柏林州和梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚州的州选举早两周。这场选举受到德国国内和国际广泛关注，原因是德国选择党（AfD）的表现，以及该党可能赢得绝对多数席位。
